sections.text_helper: Section 8.2 "PWR main features" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 224.
sections.section_content:
The power controller (PWR) main features are:
• Power supplies and supply domains
– Core domain (VCORE)
– VDD domain
– RTC domain (VRTC)
– Analog domain (VDDA)
– VDDUSB for USB transceiver
• System supply voltage regulation
– Linear voltage regulator (LDO)
• Power supply supervision
– POR/PDR monitor
– PVD monitor
• Power management
– Low-power modes
• Privileged protection
